faithful.line: She doesn't have to say she's faithful
stanza: My love, she speaks like silence
She doesn't have to say she's faithful
Yet she's true, like ice, like fire

faithful.line: They carry the weight of the faithful
stanza: My church and my country could use a little mercy now
As they sink into a poisoned pit
That's going to take forever to climb out
They carry the weight of the faithful
I love my church and country
And they could use some mercy now
